label: Mock / Show Vent

profile.distinguishingDetail: A mock or show vent is a purely decorative sleeve opening: the vent is cut and finished to appear functional, with buttons sewn neatly in a row, but the buttonholes are either blind-stitched closed or omitted so the sleeve cannot actually be unbuttoned. This construction gives the visual impression of a working cuff — projecting quality and attention to detail — while preserving the ease of alteration that a genuine functioning vent would compromise. It is the standard finish on most quality made-to-measure and high-end ready-to-wear jackets.
